newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Fotolabo 1996 sales jump on acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Fotolabo 1996 sales jump on acquisitions.

text.p: Swiss photo processing group Fotolabo AG said 1996 sales jumped 53 percent to 307 million Swiss francs, with 38 percent of the increase stemming from acquisitions over the last 1-1/2 years.
The sales rise in the photofinishing sector amounted to 15.5 percent to 201 million and at constant currency rates it would have been 14.7 percent, Fotolabo said in a statement.
Among the acquisitions was Prontophot and SOFT. The Fotolabo group is active in photofinishing by mail and in self-service photo booths.
Final results will be announced on May 13.
In Switzerland Fotolabo Club saw sales slip two percent as the total market fell five percent in volume.
In France turnover rose 20 percent, but Fotolabo said the French market remained very difficult to penetrate.
In the U.S. the sales of Mystic Color Lab was comparable to that in 1995 and it is offering new digital services to improve its competitive position.
